scope: Finite independent final challenge of exactly 23 proposed removals and reassessment of 14 existing evidence gaps. No discovery or production changes.

findings.name: Blackpoints
findings.catalogueReview: WITHDRAW: catalogue alone missed Asbera. Official product site offers maintained web/mobile SaaS for hazardous-building-material surveys; its legal notice identifies the exact Zurich Blackpoints entity. Developer-authored Google Play listing identifies Blackpoints AG and an August 2026 technology update. This is concrete own product development, not merely iGovPortal/Inventsys resale.
findings.method: Fresh official catalogue/product branch reads, public publisher evidence where identified, and explicitly reused earlier case/history evidence. Search absence is never decisive.

findings.name: Dream Production
findings.catalogueReview: WITHDRAW pending clarification: own technical articles explicitly describe an original ACF/Timber integration plugin and custom caching plugin; the WordPress publisher profile lists ACF Timber Integration and DP Debug Menu. These contradict a blanket client-only claim. Evidence dates to 2018-2021; current maintenance/use of this original technology is not established. Lack of recent public commits does not establish inactivity.
findings.method: Fresh official catalogue/product branch reads, public publisher evidence where identified, and explicitly reused earlier case/history evidence. Search absence is never decisive.

limitations: Catalogue coverage is bounded to current navigation, named product branches, prior substantive evidence and targeted publisher/product searches; it is not proof that undisclosed R&D cannot exist.
Excluded firms can do real engineering; recommendations apply the user company own-technology criterion, not technical competence or activity.
Dream Production original software is evidenced historically; no current maintenance assertion is invented.
Sparse publicity alone neither establishes eligibility nor supports exclusion. Mecas and Reasoning Labs remain protected pending substantive technical/identity clarification.
Voviva and Quantum Digital are scope questions with substantive development evidence, not generic-consultancy findings.
No new snapshot was taken in this challenge; 1041 at the recorded snapshot time remains the exact reviewed population.
